title: Profile block-import
description: An anchor, a chain schedule and an ordered block sequence imported as a node imports them. A transaction present in a supplied block is never skipped: an inclusion the rules forbid invalidates the block, and a failed import leaves the previous head and state.

anchor.description: The parent of the first block, at whose state pre holds.

ancestors.description: Hashes of the anchor's ancestors a block may read.

blocks.description: One result per input block; import stops at the first invalid block, which is the last entry.

state.description: From pre to the state of the last accepted block.
